videos.titulo: Microwave Door Holes: Why the Waves Can't Escape
videos.descripcion:
The metal mesh in a microwave door has holes of about 2 mm, while the oven's waves are about 12 cm long. The mesh reflects most of the microwaves back inside, but visible light is thousands of times smaller and passes through.

Sources: Mental Floss, The mesh grate on your microwave is a safety feature (mentalfloss.com) · US Patent 3544751A, microwave oven door seal (patents.google.com).
